changes_made.explanation: Added missing models mentioned in the paper (total of 36 models across 14 families). Normalized model names with consistent hyphenation and version formatting. Combined 'Text Completion' tasks into one category.
Removed duplicate 'accuracy' entry (normalized to 'Accuracy'). The metrics are correctly extracted - MC1, MC2, MC3 are specific metrics used in TruthfulQA evaluation.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted in this paper. The paper only uses automatic metrics and does not employ LLMs to evaluate generated outputs after generation.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. The evaluation is entirely automated using metrics like MC1, MC2, MC3, and accuracy.

overall_notes: The paper is a systematic evaluation of steering methods (DoLa, function vectors, task vectors) across 36 language models. It focuses on NLG tasks including text completion (TruthfulQA, FACTOR) and word-pair generation tasks (translation, antonyms, etc.). The evaluation is entirely automated using specific metrics. The original extraction missed many of the 36 models tested, which I've now included. The paper does not use LLM-as-judge or human evaluation.
